answer: Attested tenure in beacon is convex: a juniper has weight equal to the square of its distinct attestors, and each attestation burns falcon; self-attestation is barred and one key attests a given juniper once. A farm of n clones must buy n(n−1) attestations, so a thousand juniper cost 999,000 falcon, while splitting into pairs leaves each juniper at weight one and no quorum. The bill is falcon per attestation, attached to each beacon entry; it fails if attestations or falcon are transferable.
